description: Point-in-time supply-minus-demand features and footprint property-type baseline for satellite REIT research

built_up.name: Global Human Settlement Layer (GHSL) built-up surface
built_up.limitation: R2025A is a reprocessed historical product; it is not a point-in-time data vintage.

population.name: World Bank World Development Indicators, SP.POP.TOTL
population.limitation: National population is a coarse demand proxy for metro-level property demand.

night_lights.name: NASA Black Marble / VIIRS annual nighttime lights composites
night_lights.limitation: Cloud, sensor, saturation, stray-light and urban composition changes can bias growth; use stable annual composites and revisions manifest.

labeling_protocol: Freeze imagery and parcel/POI versions by snapshot date.
Sample buildings stratified by city, size and candidate class.
Have two reviewers label use from imagery plus parcel/POI evidence; adjudicate disagreements.
Keep cities out of validation when possible to measure geographic transfer, not memorization.
limitations: Footprint geometry alone cannot reliably identify use; the rule scores are an auditable bootstrap.
Data centers and self-storage are especially confusable with warehouses; require power/cooling or parcel evidence.
REIT holdings may be mixed-use, leased to another use, or outside the observed footprint snapshot.
